stem: Rivermark Commerce routes HTTP requests by URL path to microservices and also needs TLS termination at the load balancer.

choices.text: Network Load Balancer with TCP listeners
Gateway Load Balancer with appliance targets
Application Load Balancer with host and path routing rules

rationale: Application Load Balancer operates at Layer 7 and supports host and path routing for HTTP(S) workloads. Network Load Balancer is optimized for Layer 4 transport traffic rather than URL-path routing logic. Gateway Load Balancer is for virtual appliance insertion flows. Classic Load Balancer lacks the modern application-routing feature set expected here.
